How it works

From hello to launch.

  1. 01

    Say hello

    Message us on WhatsApp or give us a call. Tell us about your business and your current website, if you have one.

  2. 02

    We design

    We design around your business, your photos and what your customers already say about you.

  3. 03

    We build

    Build takes 1 to 2 weeks. You pay a 50% deposit to get started.

  4. 04

    We launch

    You pay the other 50% before launch. A care plan from R500 a month is there if you want us to look after it.
